t: This is St Paul's Church in Clapham, a Church of England parish church. There has been a church on this site since the 12th century, and the present building, finished in 1815, is Grade II* listed. The grounds hold fine early nineteenth-century tombs, a community garden called Eden, and a Green Flag Award. John Thornton is buried here. He was a merchant and philanthropist who gave away much of his wealth, and was said to be the second richest man in Europe when he died in 1790. Lucy Watson is also buried here.
